hyperparameters.name: Gene 10
hyperparameters.value: sets the systems size by specifying the number of nanoparticles

methods.name: ML model (neural network)
methods.description: developed to directly relate the gene set to the corresponding scattering intensity profile

methods.name: CREASE
methods.description: Utilizes a genetic algorithm to optimize for the set of genes (low dimensional feature space corresponding to a structural arrangement, S(q), and primary particle form, P(q)) that possesses a computed scattering profile(s) that most closely matches the input scattering profile(s). Outputs the real-space arrangement of the ‘primary particle’ as well as the relevant dimensions of the primary particle.

methods.name: P(q) and S(q) CREASE
methods.description: A method used to identify information about micelles and their structural arrangement using scattering profiles.

methods.name: Debye scattering approach
methods.description: Computes scattering profiles by evaluating P(q) and combining it with S(q) to obtain the overall scattering intensity I(q)
